verses.text: David went to Nob, to Ahimelek the priest. Ahimelek was trembling when he met him, and asked, "Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?"

David answered Ahimelek the priest, "The king sent me on a mission and told me, 'No one must know anything about the mission I am sending you on, or about my orders.' As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.
Now then, what do you have here? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever you can find."
But the priest answered David, "I do not have any ordinary bread here. But there is some holy bread, if the men have kept themselves away from women."
David replied, "Yes, women have been kept away from us, as always when I set out. The men's bodies are holy even on ordinary missions. How much more today!"

So the priest gave him the holy bread, since there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence. It had been taken away from before the LORD and replaced with fresh bread on the day it was removed.
Now one of Saul's servants was there that day, kept there before the LORD. He was Doeg the Edomite, the head of Saul's shepherds.
David asked Ahimelek, "Do you have a spear or a sword here? I have not brought my sword or any other weapon, because the king's mission was urgent."

The priest replied, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here. It is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it. There is no other sword here." David said, "There is none like it. Give it to me."
That day David ran away from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.
But the servants of Achish said to him, "Is this not David, the king of the land? Is he not the one they sing about in their dances: 'Saul has killed his thousands, and David his tens of thousands'?"
David took these words to heart and was very afraid of Achish king of Gath.
So he pretended to be mad in front of them. While he was with them, he acted like a madman, scribbling on the doors of the gate and letting spit run down his beard.
Achish said to his servants, "Look at the man! He is mad! Why bring him to me?
Do I not have enough madmen already, that you have to bring this fellow here to act like a madman in front of me? Must this man come into my house?"
